title: session.revoked (v1)
description: An active browser session was revoked. Emitted when an active browser (SSO) session is revoked together with its grants, refresh families and opaque tokens (back-channel logout tokens are queued for registered clients). Bulk revocations emit one event per session. Not emitted for session expiry, for already inactive sessions, or for sessions revoked by backup-restore reconciliation. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

reason.description: Machine-readable revocation reason supplied by the caller. Values currently produced: account_suspended, account_locked, deletion_requested, account_deleted, user_revoked, user_logout_all, admin_revoked, assisted_recovery, password_reset, password_changed, credential_compromised, refresh_reuse, concurrent_limit, rp_logout. New values may be added; treat unknown values as a generic revocation.

org_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
